Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
Once an order has been placed, we are unable to make changes to it or cancel it directly because orders process quickly in our system. However, if you need different items, you are welcome to place a new order for what you need and reach out to our customer support team with your new order number so we can help with standard shipping costs.
If your package has already shipped, you can also refuse delivery upon arrival and let our support team know as soon as tracking confirms it is being returned to us.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
